svg.aria-label: Subramanyam Kandlagunta, Software Engineering Specialist at GE Vernova. Ten line figures draw themselves in turn: Euclid, Elements I.1; The transistor; NAND gate; The processor; Instruction cycle; Perceptron; Neural network; Gradient descent; Attention; Agent loop.
svg.title: Subramanyam Kandlagunta, Software Engineering Specialist at GE Vernova. Ten line figures draw themselves in turn: Euclid, Elements I.1; The transistor; NAND gate; The processor; Instruction cycle; Perceptron; Neural network; Gradient descent; Attention; Agent loop.

g.text: On a given line, construct an equilateral triangle.
A switch. Every chip is billions of them.
Universal: any logic can be built from it alone.
A die, its pins, and cores working in parallel.
Fetch, decode, execute, billions of times a second.
Weighted inputs, a sum, a threshold. One neuron.
Layers of neurons. Depth is where learning lives.
Step downhill on the error until it stops falling.
Each token weighs all others. Core of transformers.
Observe, reason, act with tools, then observe again.

svg.text: I ask why until there is
